note.after_visit_summary: Thank you for coming in today. Here is what we talked about. Good to see you. The estrogen in combination pills can lower lamitrogen levels in your blood, sometimes by about half, so the dose that works now could stop being enough. It applies to anyone on it, so to sum up, your bipolar roman 2 disorder is stable on lamatrogen 200 milligrams a day, and we will keep that dose for now. Here's the plan for the pill. If you ever get a rash, especially with fever or mouth sores, stop the lamitrogen and call us or go to the emergency room. And if you miss five days or more in a row, don't restart at 200, call us, because we need to build back up slowly.
